title: Hearty Smoky Algerian Lamb Tagine
description: A dense and peppery stew originating from Algeria, this dish features salted butter and a smoky flavor, making it perfect for a cold day. It is also low in sodium, making it a great option for those with dietary restrictions.
instructions: Heat the salted butter in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the lamb pieces and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the smoked paprika, ground cumin, ground coriander, cayenne pepper, and black pepper, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add 2 cups of water and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1 1/2 hours.
Add the chopped dried apricots and continue to simmer, covered, for an additional 30 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro.
